newsitem.title: UK: Matthew Clark firm on marketing plans news.
newsitem.headline: Matthew Clark firm on marketing plans news.

text.p: Shares in Matthew Clark Plc shot 17p higher to 320-1/2p at the start of trade on Tuesday after the cider-maker unveiled marketing plans to rejuvenate its cider business.
The company also said it intended to maintain its total dividend payment after announcing first-half pre-tax profits of 21.6 million stg, up 40 percent but below its own estimates.
"The market is basically buying the share as a recovery stock. It has fallen quite a long way -- surprising considering how many cider drinkers there are in this country," one senior dealer said.
